subject.title: fix(skills): make Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals decidable and non-wedging

question: Should this PR require revision-bound Skill Workshop approval metadata before merge, or may maintainers accept the mutable-proposal approval window as a follow-up risk?
rationale: The remaining blocker is an approval-boundary choice: the code can be fixed mechanically, but maintainers may decide the shorter timeout fix should land first with the revision binding tracked separately.

options.title: Bind before merge
options.body: Require the approved lifecycle action to carry the described draftHash/proposedVersion and reject or re-prompt when the proposal changed during the approval window.

options.title: Accept follow-up risk
options.body: Land the timeout and metadata fix now and explicitly track the revision-binding approval gap as follow-up security work.

options.title: Split timeout only
options.body: Narrow this PR to the 70s timeout and actionable timeout result, leaving enriched proposal metadata for a revision-bound follow-up.

recommendation.title: Bind before merge
recommendation.body: Require the approved lifecycle action to carry the described draftHash/proposedVersion and reject or re-prompt when the proposal changed during the approval window.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is centered on Skill Workshop proposal lifecycle semantics introduced in the Skill Workshop feature PR.
